{"consolidated_memory":"SIGNATURE MISMATCH IN KEY ROTATION — crypto/keys/rotation.py (Security)
Three separate incidents, each with a distinct root cause and fix.

OCCASION 1: [2026-07-26]
- Symptom: Signature verification failure against the previous key
- Triggered by: Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: Race condition in lazy initialization
- Fix: Guarded initialization with double-checked lock (PR #1032, branch fix/signature-mismatch-1)
- Reproduction: Rotate signing key while requests are in flight
- Tests: tests/crypto/test_rotation.py
- Outcome: Error rate dropped from 2.1% to under 0.02% (2 per ten thousand)

OCCASION 2: [2026-08-09]
- Symptom: Signature verification failure against the previous key
- Triggered by: Two requests racing on the same key
- Root cause: Config loader reading wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #3464, branch fix/signature-mismatch-2)
- Reproduction: Rotate signing key while requests are in flight
- Outcome: Throughput rose 12% to 755 requests per second
- Note: Same corner of code as first incident; context carried over

OCCASION 3: [2026-08-15]
- Symptom: Signature verification failure against the previous key
- Triggered by: Sessions arriving through OAuth provider
- Root cause: Clock skew between two hosts
- Fix: Switched deadline to monotonic clock (PR #7948, branch fix/signature-mismatch-3)
- Reproduction: Rotate signing key while requests are in flight
- Tests: tests/crypto/test_rotation.py
- Outcome: Flaky test improved from 70 failures per 100 runs to zero

All work in Python stack, all in crypto/keys/rotation.py security area."}
